G1.name: Straight microchannel
G1.description: Planar straight channel, inlet y* in [0,1], walls y*=0/1, outlet +x.

G10.name: Vortex pocket (filleted top)
G10.description: Flat bottom y*=0 + filleted top recess pocket_ratio deep over L_pocket.

G11.name: Bifurcation loop with island (genus 1)
G11.description: Two branches rejoining around a capsule island (wallsIsland, psi_wall=0); branch_bias sets the split.

G12.name: Sinusoidal meander
G12.description: C1-tapered sinusoidal meander of constant width w*=1, amplitude amp_ratio, n_waves.

G13.name: Trifurcation
G13.description: Filleted trifurcation into centre (center_ratio) + two outer branches (outer_ratio) at +/- theta_deg.

G2.name: Sudden symmetric expansion
G2.description: Step expansion at x*=0 to height E; inlet y* in [0,1], outlet +x.

G3.name: Stenosis (symmetric constriction)
G3.description: Filleted stenosis throat_ratio over length L_t; inlet/outlet as G2.

G4.name: Symmetric Y-bifurcation
G4.description: Symmetric Y-split by theta_deg, daughter width daughter_ratio, filleted carina.

G5.name: Asymmetric Y-bifurcation
G5.description: Asymmetric Y-split: width_ratio splits the flow, theta_deg branch angle.

G6.name: Serpentine U-bends
G6.description: n_bends 180-deg arc U-bends of radius Rc_ratio with straight connectors.

G7.name: Expansion chamber + Y-split
G7.description: Sudden expansion E then Y-bifurcation theta_deg after chamber length L_mid.

G8.name: Cosine Venturi nozzle
G8.description: C1 cosine Venturi: converging L_conv to throat_ratio, diverging L_div.
